verdict.rationale: Stripe documents ordering, registering, and configuring readers from the Dashboard. Registration by order or serial number works immediately after unboxing, and no-code options let you accept payments without building a POS integration. The pack says nothing about the sign-up and approval flow or how quickly hardware ships, so the 'same week' outcome is unproven. Missing for 10: documented sign-up/account approval process and timing, hardware shipping/delivery timelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of a same-week time-to-first-payment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can sign up, get approved, and order hardware from the dashboard so I am taking in-person payments the same week

citations.quote: Reader management: Order, register, configure, and monitor readers from the Dashboard.
This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it, so you can use it immediately after you unbox it.
You can register smart readers in one of three ways: - Registration code - Serial number - Order number
Accept in-person payments on a compatible reader using Stripe's no-code solution.
Accept payments from the Stripe Dashboard mobile app.
